notes.title: Update to Fest Demo Build
notes.content: [p]An update is now available focusing on Bug fixes[/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Mouse would leave the screen when playing on multi montor setups or when windowed. Mouse now cips to the game space while running.[/p][/*][*][p]Special spawn vfx has been removed as it was causing performance issues. A  new version is in the works.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed sprites that had artifacts appearing, as well as sprite clipping for the Warp bullet.[/p][/*][*][p]Parry Gauge was depleting too quickly, the recharge rate has been improved, and it now reduces half as often.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Minor Patch for Next Fest
notes.content: [p]An update is now available that includes bug fixes as well as new content. Reminder there will be a live stream today with the Developer come join for some gameplay and  Q&A![/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Level would continue to play after exiting to the Title screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy Invulnerability was not working properly. Should not be target-able or interact with bullet combo's briefly after spawning.[/p][/*][*][p]Performance Tweaks, Mostly collision detection based, mobs only need to check for a collision if they actually moved that frame.[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Content[/h2][list][*][p]New Spawn VFX, rather than randomly appear Mobs will load in pixel by pixel. Mobs are invulnerable while spawning, and briefly after.[/p][/*][*][p]New Invulnerable Mob VFX, to indicate Invulnerability Mobs will flash a circle coordinated with their color. Moving forward special mobs that have their own invulnerability effect will also use similar VFX.[/p][/*][*][p]Vorbis map tweaks to enemy counts and types.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Fest Demo Update & Livestream with the Dev
notes.content: [p]An update is now available that includes bug fixes as well as new content. I will be live streaming tomorrow to showcase the new Flawless Achievements - Take no damage during a level and map. Please comment below the times you would like to see me go live![/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Asteroids collide force was to strong, causing Mobs to go flying. Force is now only applied a few times per second.[/p][/*][*][p]Game would crash after completing a Level and skipping the High Score menu.[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Content[/h2][list][*][p]'Jet' mob. Appearance is similar to the 'Twin' halves. Slightly faster, more accurate![/p][/*][*][p]The 'Twin' mob now has a chance on death to spawn 1 to 2 'Jet' mob.[/p][/*][*][p]'Battle Drone' mob. One of the strongest mobs, on death has a chance to spawn 'Drone', 'Super Drone', or 'Spawn'.[/p][/*][/list]
